Starts an action. One control height tall, padded by the text edge, with an icon side that steps in by one margin.
A button with only an icon. size-control makes it square and the same height as a text button; size-nested is the small size for inside a toolbar or field.
A set of mutually exclusive options. The pressed segment is styled by aria-pressed, not by a class.
A short label for a status or category, at the nested control size.
A message about the page or a task, tinted by its status. One line sits in the geometry of a field; a titled alert puts a large icon beside its title and the detail below.
A brief confirmation on the inverse colours. One line keeps its action inline; a toast with detail stacks title, detail and actions in one text column, with the icon and dismiss on the first line.
A labelled field built from slots: a leading icon that says what kind of value it takes, a prefix, the input, a suffix and a trailing action. The box is the control; the input inside is bare.
A native select. select-base turns on the customizable select, so the picker takes the theme; a <button> holding <selectedcontent> lets a long value end in an ellipsis instead of wrapping.
Native inputs drawn by the reset at Affine's mark size. A switch is a checkbox with role="switch".
A surface that groups related content, padded at the surface level.
Switches between views of the same thing. The selected tab is styled by aria-selected.
Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy.
Moves through pages of results. The current page is styled by aria-current.
A menu that opens with popovertarget and sits against its button with anchor-bottom. No script.
A modal <dialog> opened with the command attribute; the reset dims the page behind it.
Sections that open and close, built from <details>.
Initials on an accent solid, one control height square; a group overlaps them.
Native progress and meter, themed by the reset, or a track and a fill sized with a fraction class.
Rows of records in a surface that scrolls sideways on narrow screens.
What a view shows before it has content, with the action that fills it.
animate-spin for a short wait, animate-pulse placeholders for content that's on its way.
A hint that shows when its trigger is hovered or focused. The wrapper is a group; the hint uses group-hover: and group-focus-within:. No script.
A text field with suggestions, using the native list attribute and a <datalist>.
Column headers hold buttons; aria-sort on the header says which column sorts the rows and in which order.
Two native date fields grouped as one, with their own labels.
A card led by a 16:9 media area, then a title, a line of detail and its author.
A field for more than one line. It pads like a text field and grows with rows; the help line under it counts down.
A native range input, themed by the reset: track, fill and thumb in the accent. Its value prints beside the label in tabular figures.
A field box with a step button at each end and a bare number input between, so people can type or step.
A drop zone that is a label for a hidden file input, so a click opens the picker and the whole area is the target.
Chips inside a field box, each with its own remove button, then a bare input for the next one.
A column of links at the control height, each an icon and a label. aria-current="page" marks where you are, and current: paints it.
The app's top bar: a wordmark, the main links, then actions at the end. Below lg the links move into a menu behind a button at the start.
A numbered row of the steps in a task: done steps show a check, the current one carries aria-current="step", and a rule joins each to the next.
A modal <dialog> that sits against the end edge, opened with command. For filters and settings that work on the page behind it.
Terms and their values in a <dl>: one column on a phone, the term beside its value from sm up.
One figure in a card: what it counts, the value in tabular figures, and how it moved.
Events in order down a rule: a small round marker for each, its title and when it happened.
A <figure> with a caption naming the file and a copy button, over a <pre> that scrolls sideways rather than wrap.
A key in running text, at the nested height with the keycap's padding and corner, set in the mono face.
A message across the top of a page or region, on the accent's solid with its contrast text, and one link.
A note set apart from the text around it by a start rule and a soft fill, with a title and its detail.

The actions for one item, behind an icon button: a role="menu" popover with a rule between groups and the destructive action last, in the danger colour. A script can open the same menu on right-click with showPopover().
A preview of a person or a thing, opened from its name with popovertarget and placed with anchor-bottom. A hover card is the same card, shown by a script on hover and focus.
Folders as <details>, each a row at the control height whose caret turns when it opens, and its files indented one step. aria-current="page" marks the open file.
A month as a seven-column grid of day buttons. The chosen day is aria-pressed, today carries aria-current="date", and days from the next month are quieter.
A search field over grouped results, one line each, with the active result aria-selected and the keys in a footer. Shown here in place; on a page it is a modal <dialog> opened with ⌘K.
Related buttons in one run, a hairline (gap-px) apart. The outer ends keep the control corner; the corners that face each other drop to the small one, so the run reads as one object.
The usual action and, joined to it, a square key that opens the other ways to do it in a menu. Both halves share a variant; the group has its own name.
A label someone added, at the nested height on a full round, in a neutral, tinted, solid or draft (dashed) face. A removable tag ends in its own small round key.
Formatted prose, such as rendered Markdown or an agent's answer: a heading, paragraphs, a list, a quote and code, each block a step apart in one column at a readable measure.
The platform colour input as the swatch, a row of presets that are pressed when chosen, and the hue and lightness as labelled sliders with their values printed.
The row under a generated answer: copy, helpful and not helpful as pressed toggles, retry, the version switcher, then a quiet line of when and how long.

What an agent did, one step to a row: a round mark for its state (done, running, waiting, failed), its name, its time or status, and the detail behind a <details>. A rule joins each mark to the next: solid after a finished step, dashed after one still to come.

A message box: context chips, a text area that grows with what is typed (field-sizing-content), then one row with Attach at the start and, at the end, the model as a quiet text trigger and one round key at the full control size: Dictate while the box is empty, Send once something is typed (a few lines of script swap their hidden).

Six square cells in two groups of three, one digit each. A few lines of script move to the next cell as you type, back on Backspace, and spread a pasted or autofilled code across the cells. The first cell takes autocomplete="one-time-code", so a phone offers the code from the message.
The first step of signing in: the providers as full-width buttons, a rule, then an email field and Continue. A link to create an account sits in the lead, single sign-on at the foot.
The second step: who is signing in, with a way back, the password field with a key to show it, and the other ways in below.
A code sent by email: six cells that the platform can fill from the message, the address it went to, and a way to send another.
The first step of signing up, built like sign-in: what the plan costs in the lead, the providers, then the work email and Continue.
The second step of signing up: name and a new password, with a strength meter as the password's help line, and a way to skip the password.
The last step of signing up: the code sent to the new address, how long it lasts, and a way to change the address.
Where an invitation ends: who is already there as a group of avatars, the workspace and your role, and one button to go in.
A titled group of settings, one per row: what it does on the left, its control on the right, a rule between rows. On a phone each row stacks.
A search field that takes the free width, a segmented control for the view, and the count of what is shown, above the list it filters.
People one to a row: avatar, name and a supporting line, a role badge, and the row's actions behind one icon button at the end.
A search that found nothing: the query stays in the field, and the empty state says what was searched and offers one way out.
A panel of notifications, newest first: an unread one carries a dot at the end, labelled for screen readers, and one action marks them all read.
The body of a dialog for an action that can't be undone: what will go, a field that asks for the name, and the danger button last. Shown here in place of the dialog.
Plans side by side from lg up, each a card with a price in tabular figures, what it includes and its own button. The recommended plan takes the accent border.
Comments oldest first, each an avatar, a name with when it was written, and the text; the reply box last, where the thread ends.
Where the page sits, its title and one supporting line, with the page's actions at the end of the title row; on a phone the actions wrap under the title.
A table with a checkbox on each row. While rows are selected a bar across the top of the table says how many, and holds what can be done to all of them.
One record's facts in a card: its name and status, then terms and values that stack on a phone and sit side by side from sm up.
The first things to do, with how far along you are: done steps checked and struck through, the next one with its button.
Files below the drop zone, one to a row: a bar while uploading with a way to cancel, the size once done, and the reason and a retry when it fails.
An email field and a role on one row from sm up, the button at the end, and a line on what the role can do.
Questions as an accordion under a title, the first answer open, and a way to ask something the list doesn't cover.
What a product does, three to a row from lg up: an icon in a tinted square, a title and one sentence each.
A title, what people get and how often, and an email field that holds its own Subscribe button, at the small size in the field's trailing slot.

A conversation with an agent in one card: a header with the thread choice, the messages (yours at the end edge on the accent, the agent's as rich text with its trace and actions), and the composer last.
A round launcher that opens the chat as a popover over the page: a title bar with minimise and expand, the conversation, and the composer. The same draft stays when it closes.
The services an account is linked to, one per row: the service's mark with a check on its corner once connected, its name and state, and one action, Use or Connect.
The top of a landing page: a kicker, a headline at the display size, one sentence of what it is, and two actions, the primary first. Centred, at a readable measure.
A section heading with a kicker and a lead, then the feature grid under it.
Three or four figures in a row of cards from md up, each with what it counts and how it moved.
Quotes from people who use it, each a card with the quote and who said it, side by side from md up.
The last section of a landing page, on the accent's solid: one line of what to do, one sentence of why, and the action.
A centred heading and lead over the plans, and a line under them for anything a plan doesn't answer.
The foot of every page: the wordmark and one line, columns of links that stack on a phone, and a last row with the year and the legal links.
The frame of an app: the navbar across the top, the sidebar from md up, and the page in the rest, starting with its header.
A page header, a row of figures, then the table the figures summarise, with a link to see all of it.
